note: Accounts and clips the Format Scout studies. Structure only — never copy footage, script or audio.

house_reference.why: Supplied by Valentin on 29 Oct 2026 as the standard to hit.
pattern: Frame 0 is already the person mid-gesture — no logo, no title card, no intro.
One continuous take; energy comes from the captions and the people, not from cutting.
Captions phrase-sized, all caps, heavy condensed, white with hard dark outline, centred, ~62% down the frame.
One keyword per clip in an accent colour.
Two or three small graphic inserts as punctuation (flags in, flash on the closing handshake).
No standing CTA bar and no parked logo anywhere in the clip.
Lapel mic — the voice sits 18 dB above everything under 120 Hz.
house_reference.stored_as: Re-encoded to 720x1280 H.264 for the repo: agents shallow-clone on every run, and the original export was 98 MB. Captions stay legible and the audio is bit-identical in measurement, which is what the gates compare against.

accounts_note: No outside reference accounts are named yet — Valentin dropped the one proposed on 29 Oct 2026. Until he names one, the Format Scout studies the house reference and Ola's own best-performing posts, and does not go looking for accounts on its own.
